hq_country: USA (Austin, Texas) with origin/office in Athens, Greece (founded 2010-2012)
target_vertical: Light manufacturers, multi-channel retailers, wholesalers/distributors, e-commerce SMBs
pricing_model: Tiered subscription based on number of users, transactions, locations, products, clients, and integrations. Per-user add-ons available. Annual plan offers ~10% discount vs monthly. Extra transactions billed in 10k/25k blocks.
starting_price_usd: $150/month (Pro monthly) or $135/month (Pro annual) — includes 5 users, 50k transactions, 20 locations, 20k products, 20k clients, all integrations. Enterprise tier is custom-quoted. [uncertain] (some review sites list lower entry tiers historically)
shopify_supported: Native (built-in connector, written in C# using ShopifySharp library)
shopify_app_listing_url: [uncertain] (Megaventory primarily uses a custom app installation flow via help.megaventory.com rather than a public Shopify App Store listing)
shopify_built_for_shopify_badge: [uncertain] (no public evidence of Built for Shopify certification)
shopify_plus_partner_status: [uncertain] (no public listing in Shopify Plus Certified App Partner directory found)
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional. Products, customers, locations and inventory sync from Shopify into Megaventory on initial setup; ongoing: orders flow Shopify -> Megaventory; stock levels and fulfillment/tracking flow Megaventory -> Shopify.
shopify_synced_entities: Products, product variants, inventory/stock levels, sales orders, customers, locations/inventory locations, fulfillments (shipping/tracking pushed back to Shopify). Refunds and draft orders not explicitly documented. [uncertain] for refunds/draft orders coverage.
shopify_service_item_support: [uncertain] (no explicit documentation of non-physical/service item sync; Megaventory focuses on physical SKU inventory)
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes — multiple Shopify stores can be connected to a single Megaventory tenant, consolidating fulfillment as a single source of truth
shopify_pos_support: [uncertain] (no explicit Shopify POS integration documentation found)
shopify_b2b_catalog_support: [uncertain] (no explicit support for Shopify B2B catalogs / company locations / Plus B2B features documented)
shopify_markets_support: [uncertain] (no explicit Shopify Markets multi-market pricing / duties / landed cost integration documented)
shopify_metafield_to_erp_field_mapping: [uncertain] (no documented generic metafield <-> custom field mapping like Brightpearl)
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Automatic matching of Shopify products and variants to Megaventory SKUs by SKU code; reduces manual setup. Custom app installation flow handles initial matching.
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Near real-time — orders are imported into Megaventory as approved when placed; stock updates push back to Shopify. Built on Shopify webhooks/API via custom app. Exact polling vs webhook split [uncertain].
shopify_known_limitations: Custom app installation required (not a one-click public App Store install); occasional record inaccuracies reported by users requiring manual corrections; no documented Shopify POS / Shopify B2B / Shopify Markets deep integration; service / non-inventory items handling not documented.
etsy_supported: Third-party (via Zapier only; no native connector)
etsy_native_or_third_party: Third-party — only available through Zapier middleware
etsy_listing_creation_vs_sync_only: [uncertain] (depends on Zapier triggers/actions; no native listing creation)
etsy_inventory_sync: Possible via Zapier zaps; limited by Zapier task volume and Etsy connector capabilities. No native, real-time inventory sync.
etsy_order_import: Via Zapier — typically triggered per new Etsy order; not real-time webhook driven within Megaventory itself
etsy_synced_entities: [uncertain] — limited to whatever Zapier's Etsy connector triggers expose (typically new orders, new listings); no native deep integration
etsy_known_limitations: No native Etsy integration. Zapier-only setup means per-task pricing, scaling issues at order volume, no support for personalization/variation nuances, and no support for digital products. Inventory sync direction and frequency are constrained by Zapier.
amazon_supported: Third-party (via Zapier; also listed as integrating with 'Amazon Business'). No native Amazon Seller Central / SP-API integration.
amazon_marketplaces: [uncertain] (depends on Zapier's Amazon Seller / Amazon MWS connector coverage)
amazon_seller_types: [uncertain] (Zapier-based; no native FBA inbound or Vendor Central support documented)
amazon_synced_entities: Via Zapier: typically new orders and inventory updates. No documented native sync of settlements, returns, FBA inventory, or messaging.
amazon_listing_creation: No — sync only via Zapier (cannot create Amazon listings from Megaventory)
amazon_repricing_support: No (not included; would require third-party repricer)
amazon_buy_shipping: No (no in-app Amazon Buy Shipping label purchase)
amazon_fba_inbound_workflow: [uncertain] (no documented native FBA inbound creation workflow)
amazon_sp_api_inbound_v2024_03_20: Not applicable — no native SP-API integration; reliant on Zapier connectors
amazon_settlement_report_handling: No native settlement report ingestion or summary journal posting to accounting documented
amazon_multi_account_support: [uncertain] (would depend on Zapier configuration per account)
amazon_known_limitations: No native Amazon integration. Zapier-based setup is fine for low-volume sellers but cost and reliability become problematic at scale. No FBA-specific workflows, no settlement reconciliation, no repricer, no Buy Shipping.
xero_supported: Third-party (via Zapier only; no native Xero connector)
xero_app_store_certified: Not listed on the Xero App Store as a native integration. [uncertain] for any listing of the Zapier-based pattern.
xero_app_awards_recognition: No (no Xero Global App Award recognition known)
xero_synced_entities: Via Zapier: typically suppliers <-> Xero contacts, customers <-> contacts, and invoices/bills based on user-built zaps. No deep, native sync of payments, COGS journals, inventory adjustments, or credit notes.
xero_accounting_sync_mode: Effectively invoice_per_order (one Megaventory document -> one Xero invoice/bill) via Zapier. No summary journal mode. [uncertain] on full coverage.
xero_cogs_journal_method: No documented native COGS journaling to Xero (would require manual journals or export). [uncertain]
xero_known_limitations: No native integration — Zapier-only. Not ideal for businesses needing tight, automated accounting sync. Zapier task limits and free-plan caps apply. No COGS journals, no tracking-category mapping, no settlement reconciliation.
qb_online_supported: Yes — native QuickBooks Online integration (built-in connector, recommended path)
qb_desktop_supported: No — Megaventory does not offer native integration with QuickBooks Desktop (CSV/XLS export only)
qb_app_certified: Listed on Intuit QuickBooks App Store (quickbooks.intuit.com/app/apps/appdetails/megaventory). [uncertain] on specific certification badge.
qb_app_store_rating: [uncertain] (Intuit app store rating not surfaced clearly in search results)
qb_synced_entities: Products/items/services, customers (Clients), vendors (Suppliers), sales invoices, purchase invoices/bills, goods-in (purchase receipts), goods returns to supplier. Documents flow one-way Megaventory -> QuickBooks (documents created in QBO are NOT synced back to Megaventory). Payments and credit notes coverage [uncertain].
qb_accounting_sync_mode: invoice_per_order — each Megaventory sales/purchase document is pushed as a corresponding invoice/bill in QuickBooks Online (not summary journal).
qb_cogs_journal_method: [uncertain] — Megaventory pushes product cost during initial sync; ongoing COGS handling via QBO product cost field but no detailed perpetual-per-movement COGS journal documentation found.
qb_multi_currency: [uncertain] (Megaventory supports multi-currency internally; QBO multi-currency posting behavior not explicitly documented)
qb_class_location_mapping: Partial — Megaventory inventory locations can be mapped to QuickBooks locations, but addresses must be manually entered in QuickBooks. Class mapping [uncertain].
qb_known_limitations: One-way push (Megaventory -> QBO); documents created in QBO won't sync back. Goods In / Purchase Invoices / Goods Returns cannot use QBO automatic numbering. Initial sync requires no concurrent edits in QBO. Manual address entry needed in QBO for locations.
other_ecom_channels: Native WooCommerce (official WooCommerce Marketplace extension and WordPress plugin), native Magento integration. BigCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, eBay, Walmart, TikTok Shop, Faire, Square — available via Zapier only. SPS Commerce connector for EDI-style B2B is listed.
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes — Megaventory supports BOMs and assemblies; selling a finished good consumes the underlying components through production orders. Kit/bundle behavior is achieved through the Production / Work Order module.
other_accounting_integrations: Native: QuickBooks Online only. Other accounting systems (Xero, Sage, Zoho Books, MYOB, FreshBooks, NetSuite, Wave) are integrated only via Zapier or via the Data Export module (CSV/XLS) for manual import.
bom_support: Yes — full Bill of Materials support
multi_level_bom: Yes — supports multi-level / nested BOMs and sub-assemblies
production_orders: Yes — production / work orders with raw material consumption, finished goods receipt, WIP tracking, and bulk processing of production orders
batch_lot_tracking: Yes — batch / lot number tracking with expiry dates
serial_tracking: Yes — serial number tracking for both raw materials/components (via Allocate pop-up in Production Order) and finished goods
bin_location_support: [uncertain] — multi-location supported, but bin/aisle/sub-location within a single warehouse is not clearly documented as a first-class feature
multi_warehouse: Yes — multiple inventory locations; Pro plan includes 20 locations
barcoding: Yes — barcode generation, label printing, and scanning via USB/Bluetooth scanners or mobile camera
purchase_orders: Yes — PO creation, partial receipts, supplier price lists, supplier-specific SKUs
supplier_management: Yes — supplier records, lead times, MOQs, supplier-SKU mapping
landed_cost_support: Yes — landed cost feature allocates transportation, taxes, duties, insurance, and currency conversion to inventory cost
multi_currency_inventory_valuation: Multi-currency supported with real-time exchange rates; valuation per-currency vs single base [uncertain]
ai_demand_forecasting: Indirect — via integration with Lokad (probabilistic forecasting engine). Megaventory itself does not have built-in native AI forecasting; users export historical sales data to Lokad for analysis.
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Partial — through Lokad integration (Lokad computes economically optimal purchase order quantities). Megaventory has reorder-point alerts natively but not AI-generated PO drafts.
ai_natural_language_query: [uncertain] (no public documentation of a chat-style 'ask your inventory' assistant)
public_api: Yes — REST API documented at api.megaventory.com; comprehensive coverage of products, documents, inventory, customers, suppliers; API key auth
webhook_event_coverage: Extensive — Product/Category/Supplier/Client/Currency/DocumentType/Tax/Discount/InventoryLocation/IntegrationLog/ShippingProvider/PricingRule/WeightUnit Insert/Update/Delete events, plus InventoryStockAlert, DocumentInsert/Update/Approved. Configured via EventSubscriptionAdd / EventSubscriptionDelete endpoints.
integration_architecture: Hybrid — native built-in connectors for Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, QuickBooks Online, ShipStation, Lokad, SPS Commerce; Zapier for everything else (Amazon, Etsy, eBay, BigCommerce, Xero, etc.)
zapier_make_support: Yes — first-class Zapier integration with 90+ Megaventory triggers and many actions; Make/n8n support [uncertain]
mobile_app: Yes — native iOS and Android apps (launched/refreshed 2025); supports core inventory, sales orders, internal transfers, shipping/receiving, and inventory taking
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Yes — built into the Megaventory mobile app; uses phone camera or Bluetooth scanner
rate_limit_handling_documented: [uncertain] (no prominent public documentation of throttle/rate-limit handling for downstream Shopify/QBO/Amazon APIs)
sync_frequency: Shopify: near real-time (webhook + API). QuickBooks Online: real-time push on document approval. Lokad: on-demand. Zapier-based integrations (Amazon, Etsy, Xero, BigCommerce, etc.): polling frequency depends on Zapier plan (typically 1-15 minutes).
shipping_carrier_integrations: Native ShipStation integration provides access to 100+ carriers indirectly (USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, etc. via ShipStation). Direct carrier connections [uncertain].
shipping_label_buying: Indirect via ShipStation integration. No native in-app label purchase like Veeqo's free Amazon Buy Shipping.
three_pl_integrations: Native ShipStation; SPS Commerce for EDI. No native ShipBob / ShipHero / Extensiv / Deliverr integrations documented (would require Zapier).
g2_rating: [uncertain] (G2 listing exists at g2.com/products/megaventory but exact star rating and review count not clearly surfaced; aggregate user satisfaction across review sites reported at ~89%)
notable_customers: [uncertain] (no high-profile named customers found in public case studies; primary user base is SMB manufacturers and multi-channel retailers)
last_major_release: 2025-2026 — Major mobile app refresh (iOS + Android) launched May 2025 with barcode scanning, sales order shipping, inventory taking. Ongoing blog/feature content through 2026 around batch tracking, AI forecasting, Shopify ERP integration for manufacturers (Mar 2026).
owner_parent_company: Independent — Megaventory Inc. (privately held, not acquired)
last_funding_event: Early-stage backing from Athens Startup Business Incubator and National Bank of Greece (per PitchBook); no recent disclosed funding round. [uncertain] on exact dates/amounts.
public_status_page_uptime: http://status.megaventory.com (public status page exists). Specific recent uptime % [uncertain].
